notes: Each case: resolved_inputs, metadata, material_grades and section_designations per role, or an 'error' entry when merge_design_pref_sync raised.
Inputs are each frontend config's defaultInputs (fixtures/design_pref_sync_inputs.json).
Cases: open*, refresh*, save*, reset*; *_draft sends design_pref_draft, *_saved_overrides / *_stale_prefs put non-driver pref values in inputs, *_changed_driver moves the dock grade.
Header Plate Connection and Plate Girder Design are absent from _CORE_CLASS_MAP: they get no core defaults, so defaulted_keys stays empty.

_get_core_defaults swallows every exception, so a core class that raises KeyError for a pref key (most flexure, compression and tension classes do) silently yields fewer defaults; the goldens pin which keys survive.
Butt/Lap Joint modules have empty _MATERIAL_SYNC_RULES: no driver, no linked keys, no material rows.
Compression Member Design has no frontend config; its inputs are Struts Welded to End Gusset's.
